```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(janitor)
```

# pat mahomes career passing yards
```{r}
url <- "https://www.pro-football-reference.com/players/M/MahoPa00/gamelog/"
objs <-
  url %>%
  read_html() %>%
  html_nodes("table") %>%
  html_table()

pass_yards <- objs[[1]]
```

```{r}
pass_yards <- 
  pass_yards %>%
  row_to_names(row_number = 1) %>%
  select(14) %>%
  slice(-2, -19, -34, -50, -68, -86, -103, -120) %>%
  mutate(
    passing_yards = parse_number(Yds)
  ) %>% select(2)
```

```{r}
write_csv(pass_yards, "mahomes_pass_yards.csv")
```
